key_insight: Even and odd dipole screening modify the classical Eshelby response in amorphous solids, producing anomalous displacement and strain fields with higher-order Fourier modes.
engineering_relevance: These analytical fields can help interpret measured deformation patterns and refine elasto-plastic descriptions of amorphous materials.
method: Solve the two-dimensional Eshelby problem with even and odd dipole screening.
Derive analytical displacement and strain fields.
Decompose displacements into Fourier modes and compare strains with classical elasticity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports analytical solutions and higher-order mode excitation, but no quantitative experimental or simulation validation.
watch_item: Higher-order modes suggest possible nonlinear mode coupling, but the abstract does not establish that mechanism.
paper_title: The Outer Eshelby Problem in Amorphous Solids with Odd Dipole Screening
